description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Karuwalagahagara, Kotawehera D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 421157 (24/0487)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their numbers, extents, and ownership details (all listed as "The State"). The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
